entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. I need to return something right now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
The name is Alex Thompson. Order number is... VF88-12-90-15. This is ridiculous, I just want my money back.

Okay, Alex, I'm pulling up your account now. I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered about 25 days ago. I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
There's no 'issue'! It's not broken. I just changed my mind, okay? It was a total impulse buy for a New Year's resolution that's already over. I simply don't use it and I want a refund.
Okay, I understand. So just to confirm, the device is working as expected, but you've decided it's not the right product for you at this time.
That's what 'changed my mind' means, isn't it?! Your website says 90 days. I want my money back. Are you going to process this or do I need your manager?
I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull up our current return policy to confirm the details for this item. One moment please.

You'd better hurry up. I'm not going to be forced to sell this on some sketchy resale website. If you don't take this back, I'm lighting you up on every review site out there. Get me a manager right now!

There's no need for that, Alex, I can handle this for you. I've got the policy right here and... yes, our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it just 25 days ago, you are well within that window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh. Okay. Well, good. That's what I thought. See? That wasn't so hard.

Not at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address we have on file for you. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Alright, fine. That works. Just make sure that email comes through.
It was sent just now. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Alex?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
